title: Toy Story
synopsis: A cowboy doll, a new space ranger, a kid named Andy, and a road trip across a backyard fence that ends at a pizza place.

nodes.text: Andy's mother carries cake into a living room while you organize a recon.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Send the soldiers” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Hide” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Cautious.

nodes.text: You and Buzz watch a new toy meet Andy and you remember what it felt like, and you decide to be the welcoming committee from now on, forever.
You and Buzz become the team that handles backyard rescues, and the toys talk about you both like a small fire department.
The kid is dreaming. Buzz hums the theme from the commercial. You sit on the edge of the bed and you do not, for once, plan anything.
